get_template_random_dialogue: pick a random dialogue template for a given action type like Move or Build
get_template_single_turn: get a single-turn dialogue template by setting dialogue_len to 1 in template_attr
get_template_no_composites: get a dialogue template excluding inbuilt composites by setting no_inbuilt_composites to True
get_template_with_node: get a dialogue template instantiated with a specific node and template attributes
review_template_map: review the template_map dictionary that maps 14 action types to their dialogue template lists
